purpose: four already-seen controlled tests, retrospective comparison of same-block complete historical proxy with original full-window proxy and metadata baselines
design_usage: all reference values and old scores seen; 2019 gap structure and one unintegrated endpoint pair seen; NOT independent or blind confirmation

rest_proxy.anchor: first confirmation row: start+299 native seconds, median voltage of last 60 rows divided by 40
rest_proxy.maximal_runs: contiguous finite non-interpolated rows with abs(I)<=0.15; use only first confirmation per run

roles.current_threshold: 0.01C of nominal 15Ah, within publisher candidate range; fixed engineering choice
roles.duration: publisher says several minutes; 300s is fixed engineering choice, no fitted OCV
roles.high_threshold: publisher describes S_LMO EOC relaxation region above 4.1V; proxy not proof of full SOC
roles.low_threshold: 3.5V is explicit engineering low-voltage proxy, not manufacturer EOD or proven SOC=0
roles.tail_median: noise-resistant recorded-voltage proxy; not fitted equilibrium OCV

inherited_pairing.rule: scan anchors chronologically; latest high anchor becomes open start, middle anchors leave it open; each low consumes that start even if resulting interval fails; no repeated low reuse
inherited_pairing.integration: left rectangle on native timestamps [high_anchor, low_anchor); low_anchor is needed to confirm terminal state and is excluded from integral
inherited_pairing.quality: all rows from high through low anchor inclusive are finite, native consecutive seconds, Interpolated=0; no added interpolation or lag correction
inherited_pairing.sign_requirement: net measured Ah and UI energy strictly positive; any charging inside interval retained and reported
inherited_pairing.missing_start: low anchor with no preceding high is recorded, never invented
inherited_pairing.selection: latest eligible low-anchor available before cutoff; deterministic ties by high-anchor; no selection by reference proximity
inherited_pairing.fallback: if no candidate qualifies, feature remains unavailable; no nominal fill or exclusion of target test

information.embargo_basis: conservative engineering assumption inspired by author average preparation/test/follow-up of about two days; actual prep onset unknown
information.available_time_assumption: all included native rows are retrospectively available by history cutoff; no actual reception logs
information.timezone: native source strings only; absolute timezone not assumed
information.isolation: rows at or after cutoff, including test/preparation, excluded from feature computation; labels joined after selection

reference.status: author-reported controlled field DC usable quantities; shared measurement chain, not VPP commitment truth
reference.numbers_role: labels only, not used to pick history, anchors or candidate intervals

changed_rules.history_gate: allow incomplete fixed history; partition by native time difference!=1 second; do not resample or extend any original history window
changed_rules.gap_reset: clear rest tail and pending high at every time gap; no pair crosses a gap
changed_rules.left_censoring: first rest run of an observed block beginning at its first row has unknown physical onset; record but exclude its anchor from pairing, including at window start; keep all excluded records
changed_rules.pair_quality: both eligible anchors in same block; all rows high through low inclusive finite and Interpolated=0, consecutive native seconds; net I and UI both strictly positive
changed_rules.pair_selection: latest eligible low then high by native time, across all observed blocks; no reference value or prediction error used; no preferred event or block
changed_rules.integral: same left rectangle [high,low), -sum(I)/3600 Ah and -sum(I*U)/3600000 kWh; charging retained; no unseen drain/OCV/efficiency correction
changed_rules.age: report low-to-history-cutoff and low-to-test age seconds/days; no fitted or invented freshness cutoff; old spans remain historical proxies, not current capability
changed_rules.unavailable: retain event/model/output and explicit reason, no nominal fallback or dropping failed cases

comparison.old_models: copy only exact frozen previous predictions after new features exist; recompute their metrics against matching original published XLSX labels; preserve original missing status
comparison.new_model: B_LOCAL_SPAN uses newly frozen latest eligible same-block span; fit none
comparison.reporting: per event and output, all 32 rows incl unavailable; number of events with predictions separately, no posthoc averaged score or accuracy claim

no_search: no threshold, age cutoff, history extension, exclusion or parameter search after new score; changes need new protocol
scope: one system, shared measurement chain, voltage proxy not true full SOC or VPP maximum; no proof of stable superiority or 90% goal
